% A revtex4 article for aps with hyperref, with a single appendix from
% \appendix*: one section with a title and a \label, and one with no
% title, whose heading is "Appendix" alone, as in the PDF. A \ref to the
% appendix is empty, as in the PDF.
\documentclass{revtex4}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\begin{document}
\title{Revfour appendix with hyperref}
\author{Someone}
\maketitle
\section{First section}
Text of the first section, before appendix~[\ref{app:linked}].
\appendix*
\section{Linked appendix}\label{app:linked}
Text of the linked appendix.
\begin{equation}
a = b \label{eq:linked}
\end{equation}
Text after Eq.~(\ref{eq:linked}).
\section{}
Text of the bare appendix.
\end{document}
